items.title: Replace hardcoded API secrets with cryptographically secure random generation
acceptance_criteria: API secrets are generated using crypto.randomBytes() at startup
Secrets are stored in secure app state, not hardcoded
Each instance has unique secret, not reused across sessions
API key validation uses constant-time comparison
items.approach: Generate random 32-byte secret at extension initialization. Store in memory with secure lifecycle management. Update generateApiKey to use dynamic secret.

items.title: Implement strict authentication validation on MLX HTTP endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Authorization header validation uses constant-time comparison
Empty or malformed bearer tokens are rejected
Rate limiting implemented on chat endpoint (max 10 req/sec per connection)
Failed auth attempts logged with timestamp and source
items.approach: Use constant-time string comparison for bearer token. Implement simple in-memory rate limiter with sliding window. Add logging for auth failures.

items.title: Secure HuggingFace token storage using system keychain
acceptance_criteria: HF token retrieved from system keychain on demand, not stored in memory
Token only in memory during active API requests
Fallback to plaintext only if keychain unavailable (with warning)
Token cleared from memory immediately after request completion
items.approach: Integrate with Tauri's credential storage or system keychain. Retrieve token only when _getHeaders() is called. Use try-finally to ensure cleanup.

items.title: Add path traversal protection and input validation for file uploads
acceptance_criteria: File paths validated against whitelist of allowed directories
Path traversal attempts (.., ~, absolute paths) rejected
Symbolic links cannot escape sandbox
File existence and ownership verified before ingestion
items.approach: Use Path.resolve() and verify resolved path is within allowed directory. Reject paths containing '..' or starting with '/'. Add whitelist check.

items.title: Implement thread/message ownership verification in conversational extension
acceptance_criteria: All thread operations verify ownership before execution
Message list operations scoped to owned threads only
Delete/modify operations verify message author
Audit log created for sensitive operations
items.approach: Add ownership context parameter to all operations. Check thread/message ownership against current session. Implement audit logging.

items.title: Add access control checks to vector database operations
acceptance_criteria: All vector DB operations scoped to thread context
File attachment ownership verified before access
Collection access restricted to thread owner
Sensitive operations logged for audit trail
items.approach: Wrap vector DB operations with thread context validation. Verify file ownership. Implement audit logging.

items.title: Validate backend string format against whitelist
acceptance_criteria: Backend string format strictly validated (version/backend pattern)
Both parts checked against known supported values
Invalid formats rejected with clear error message
No path traversal possible via backend string
items.approach: Extract version and backend parts, validate each against whitelist. Use enum for backend types instead of strings where possible.

items.title: Implement session limits and load request throttling
acceptance_criteria: Maximum 3 concurrent model loads enforced
Load requests rate limited to 1 per 2 seconds
System resource checks before allowing new model load
Memory usage must be <80% of available before load
items.approach: Add load queue with concurrency limit. Implement rate limiter with token bucket. Check available memory before load.

items.title: Add rate limiting to model loading endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Per-endpoint rate limit: max 5 load requests per minute
Exponential backoff on repeated failures (2s, 4s, 8s)
Rate limit headers included in responses
Rejection with 429 Too Many Requests when limit exceeded
items.approach: Add RateLimiter middleware. Implement exponential backoff for failures. Return 429 with Retry-After header.

items.title: Refactor ChatInput container into smaller focused components
acceptance_criteria: ChatInput split into 5 focused components, each <400 LOC
Single responsibility for each component
Props clearly defined and documented
Container orchestrates but doesn't implement logic
items.approach: Extract ChatInputField (text input), AttachmentPanel (file handling), ChatInputToolbar (model/tool UI), keep ChatInputContainer for orchestration.

items.title: Decompose llamacpp extension into domain modules
acceptance_criteria: index.ts reduced to <500 LOC orchestration only
Each module has single clear responsibility
No circular dependencies between modules
Clear interfaces for module interaction
All tests pass and coverage maintained
items.approach: Extract backend management, device detection, model loading, inference, settings into separate modules. Keep index.ts as coordinator.

items.title: Split MLX extension into focused modules
acceptance_criteria: index.ts reduced to <400 LOC
MLX runtime setup isolated in mlx-runtime.ts
Model quantization logic in model-quantizer.ts
Inference execution in inference-engine.ts
Memory optimization in memory-optimizer.ts
items.approach: Extract Metal GPU setup, quantization logic, inference streaming, memory management into separate modules.

items.title: Decompose proxy.rs reverse proxy into focused modules
acceptance_criteria: proxy.rs reduced to <500 LOC orchestration
Request transformation isolated
Response handling separated
Streaming logic in own module
Error translation centralized
Security checks in security_filter
items.approach: Extract request transformation, response handling, streaming, error handling, and security validation into separate Rust modules.

items.title: Introduce service abstraction layer to reduce hook coupling
acceptance_criteria: ServiceFacade provides unified interface to multiple services
Hooks depend on facade, not individual services
Service swapping doesn't break hooks
Dependency injection possible for testing
items.approach: Create ServiceFacade that aggregates Thread, Message, Assistant, Model, Provider services. Update hooks to use facade.

items.title: Create IPC abstraction layer to centralize Tauri invocations
acceptance_criteria: TauriClient/IPCBridge wraps all tauri.invoke calls
Centralized command definition and response mapping
Consistent error handling and retry logic
Mock-friendly for testing
items.approach: Create TauriClient class with methods for each command. Inject into services. Implement retry and error handling at IPC level.

items.title: Standardize extension dependency injection patterns
acceptance_criteria: All extensions implement consistent ExtensionInterface
Constructor-based DI for all dependencies
Clear, documented lifecycle hooks
Consistent event naming and payload schemas
items.approach: Define ExtensionInterface in core. Update all extensions to use constructor DI. Standardize event contracts.

items.title: Move business logic from large containers to services
acceptance_criteria: MessageItem reduced to <150 LOC presentation only
DropdownModelProvider reduced to <200 LOC
DownloadManegement reduced to <150 LOC
Business logic moved to respective services
Containers call services via hooks only
items.approach: Extract message processing, provider validation, download orchestration into services. Update containers to use hooks.

items.title: Create centralized configuration system
acceptance_criteria: Configuration separated by domain (API, UI, extensions)
Support environment-based config loading
Runtime config updates possible
Provider definitions centralized, not hardcoded
items.approach: Create Config.ts with environment loading. Separate concerns: ApiConfig, UIConstants, ExtensionSettings. Support dynamic loading.

items.title: Clarify data flow between providers and hooks
acceptance_criteria: Unidirectional data flow documented and enforced
No circular dependencies between hooks and providers
State updates flow: UI → Hooks → Services → Backend → DataProvider
Clear dispatch patterns for state mutations
items.approach: Document data flow. Use Redux/Zustand for clear state management. Add linting rules to prevent circular dependencies.

items.title: Split large hooks into smaller, focused hooks
acceptance_criteria: Each hook <200 LOC with single responsibility
No hook depends on another hook directly
Clear prop interfaces for custom hooks
Reusable across components
items.approach: Split useModelProvider into config/models/updates. Split useLocalApiServer into lifecycle/config/health. Split useBackendUpdater into version/download/orchestration.

items.title: Establish command adapter pattern for Tauri commands
acceptance_criteria: CommandHandler trait defined for all Tauri commands
Unified response wrapper with consistent error handling
Centralized request validation
Command contracts documented in schema
items.approach: Create CommandHandler trait. Implement error wrapper. Centralize validation. Document command specs.

items.title: Centralize authentication and authorization in security layer
acceptance_criteria: SecurityService handles all approval logic
PermissionGuard component wraps sensitive operations
Unified authorization checks
Audit logging for all approvals
items.approach: Create SecurityService for approvals. Extract from hooks. Implement PermissionGuard. Add audit logging.

items.title: Establish consistent error handling patterns across all modules
acceptance_criteria: ErrorResponse type defined across all layers
ErrorBoundary components for each layer
Centralized error logging and reporting
Standardized error codes and messages
Consistent HTTP status codes
items.approach: Define ErrorResponse interface. Create error handlers for TypeScript/Rust/Extensions. Implement centralized logging. Standardize codes.

items.title: Establish clear testing layer boundaries and mocking patterns
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests isolated from services via mocks
Integration tests use real services with fixtures
Clear mock factory for common objects
Test utils documented
items.approach: Create test utilities: factories.ts for objects, mocks.ts for service mocks, enhance setup.ts with fixtures.

items.title: Unify i18n system across web-app and docs
acceptance_criteria: Shared translation files between web-app and docs
Centralized i18n configuration
Single source of truth for translation keys
CLI tool for translation management
items.approach: Unify i18n config. Share locale files. Create translation management tool. Document key naming conventions.

items.title: Encrypt sensitive preferences stored in localStorage
acceptance_criteria: Backend type preference encrypted at rest in localStorage
Use client-side encryption (AES-256)
Decrypted only when needed
Implement CSP headers to mitigate XSS
items.approach: Use TweetNaCl.js or libsodium.js for encryption. Encrypt before storage, decrypt on retrieval. Add CSP headers.

items.title: Add CSRF protection to MLX server endpoints
acceptance_criteria: CSRF token validation for POST requests
Origin/Referer header verification
SameSite cookie attribute set
CORS policy documented
items.approach: Add CSRF token generation and validation. Verify Origin header. Set SameSite=Strict on cookies.

dependencies.reason: Auth validation depends on secure API key generation being in place first
Rate limiting requires load queue infrastructure from session limits fix
Vector DB access control should mirror thread ownership checks
Moving logic from containers to services requires service facade abstraction
Clarifying data flow needs service abstraction in place
Hook decomposition works better with service facade

dedup_summary: Merged F-3eed6a38 and F-cb1b4772 into single 'rate limiting and session management' fix. Consolidated F-8dff9e10, F-1f74fe1f, F-b88b5afc, F-72895412 as parallel refactoring tasks (god module decomposition). Unified F-8e6344a8, F-6f66256f, F-32e5d7ba, F-7f308db8, F-1cd0409d, F-0b447224 as architecture layer improvements executed together.
summary: 27 actionable remediation items across 4 execution levels. Level 1 (6 items): Input validation, secrets, CSRF hardening. Level 2 (11 items): Authentication enforcement, token management, architecture abstraction. Level 3 (7 items): Authorization checks, hook/container refactoring, service decomposition. Level 4 (3 items): Large module decomposition (god module fixes). Critical path: API secret generation (F-7d74336a) → auth validation (F-de3ebc7f) → token security (F-1f437170). Architecture improvements can proceed in parallel. No findings deferred; all are actionable within development capacity.
